meta_description: How to permanently delete your VpnHood! account and the personal data linked to it, from inside the app or on the web.
page_desc:
You can permanently delete your VpnHood! account and the personal data linked to it in two ways:

1. In the app (fastest): open the Account page and choose Delete my account.

2. On the web, without the app: sign in to the account portal and choose Delete my account. If you have never set a password, use Forgot password with the email address you signed in with.

Deletion applies to all devices and cannot be undone — signing in again later creates a new, empty account. Deleting your account does not cancel a subscription: cancel it in the store where you purchased it, before or after deleting. Invoices are kept for legal reasons with your personal details replaced by anonymous placeholders.

Questions? Contact support@vpnhood.com.
